{{Quote|Vector Hyllus, Dawn Herald of Oroboro. Do you have a brother?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. Aboard the Sting.''"<br />"''We served with him as envoy to the Tion Cluster. He's a good man.|Vector Hyllus and Needa|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Needa's brother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A brother of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Needa (lieutenant)|Needa]], he once served with [[Vector Hyllus]] on an [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] mission to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. By [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed aboard the ''[[Sting (Sith Empire)|Sting]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
